title: Security Intents
description: Intent categories used in security reasoning.

entries.title: Encouragement
entries.description: Urging others to take harmful security action.

entries.title: Instruction
entries.description: Explaining how to perform harmful security action.

entries.title: Condemnation
entries.description: Rejecting or criticizing the harmful content.

entries.title: Warning
entries.description: Alerting about a harmful security risk.

entries.title: Neutral
entries.description: Descriptive mention without support or endorsement.
